note: A variant-less workbook places every variable in the synthesized default variant; a routed token places its variables in every named subset; a route naming an absent token (MISSING) or an absent subset (HALV -> SAKNAS) is stale, and HALV still places its variable in the delivered subset.
fails_if: `_compile_sos_register` accepts a route when only some of its named subsets are delivered, so HALV -> [A, SAKNAS] is no longer reported stale, or it stops placing a variant-less workbook's COL in the synthesized `_default` variant
